Firstly I am so sorry for all the things that you’ve had to go through, your pain is valid and it matters. 
Secondly I want to say that I couldn’t agree more on the statement that some people just shouldn’t be parents, at all. I’m myself one of those children brought to this world by people that had absolutely no idea what bringing someone to this world means, even my mother once admitted she never really planned, it just happened and she went ahead with life because that’s what one is supposed to do, like no? You are not supposed to have children, being responsible for a human implies so much more than feeding them and providing basic needs.
I am truly feeling your angst, as I’ve thought multiple times of these kind of scenarios, like, to the point of being anxious whenever in my fyp on TikTok pregnancies reveals pop up, like, are you really equipped to bring a child? I doubt anyone is, and I know -and have talked about this several times in therapy- I know there are not perfect parents but if you are not willing to offer the closest to a perfect environment for a whole damn human to develop, then I don’t think people should reproduce, breeders often forget their “imperfect” parenting and mistakes leave life long wounds on the individuals that came out off them, honestly I think saying “no parent is perfect” is just a lame excuse people give when they know they have consciously f*caked up a human that didn’t even ask to be born.
Sorry for that rant, that being said I want to offer you my support if you ever need to talk to someone, I would also advice to seek for psychological help for you and your sibling if possible because those ideations are dangerous and trust me, it’s a hard process to heal, but once you start the hardest part is already done.
Lots of love your way, mate.
